title: Investment Fund Collateral Response
description: Provides details on the investment fund collateral withdrawal.

collateralIdentification.description: Collateral identification as known by party. Its identification is generated by the requesting party

assetNumber.description: Identifies the register number of the collateral deposit assigned by the central counterparty

executedMovementType.description: Executed movement type for collateral operations. For investment fund collateral only 1 (Financial Institution) is accepted

quantity.description: Quantity of investment fund shares requested to collateral withdrawal

collateralStatus.description: This block contains information on the status of each collateral processing
